CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO ratios_asof(d) AS TABLE 
    WITH c AS (
        WITH ms AS (SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS session_date),
        ltype AS (SELECT security_id, mode(finra_type) AS line_type FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/security_master/finra_names.parquet') GROUP BY 1),
        lk AS (SELECT m.session_date, l.security_id, l.cik, l.link_tier, l.linkprim
               FROM ms m JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/identity/link_table_v3.parquet') l
                 ON m.session_date BETWEEN l.valid_from AND coalesce(l.valid_to, DATE '2100-01-01')
               LEFT JOIN ltype t ON t.security_id = l.security_id
               WHERE l.link_tier IN ('strict', 'dated', 'name') AND l.linkprim IN ('P', 'J') AND l.cik IS NOT NULL
                 AND l.available_at <= CAST(m.session_date AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL 22 HOUR
                 AND coalesce(t.line_type NOT IN ('preferred', 'warrant', 'unit', 'right', 'note', 'ETF', 'ETN', 'fund'), true)),
        px AS (SELECT p.session_date, p.security_id, p.close AS prc FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/prices/year=*/prices.parquet', union_by_name = true) p
               WHERE p.session_date IN (SELECT session_date FROM ms) AND p.close > 0),
        sh AS (SELECT s.session_date, s.security_id, s.shrout FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/market/shares_daily/year=*/shares_daily.parquet', union_by_name = true) s
               WHERE s.session_date IN (SELECT session_date FROM ms)),
        c0 AS (SELECT lk.*, px.prc, sh.shrout, sh.shrout * px.prc AS me_line
               FROM lk JOIN px USING (session_date, security_id) LEFT JOIN sh USING (session_date, security_id))
        SELECT c0.*,
               CASE WHEN count(*) OVER w = count(me_line) OVER w THEN sum(me_line) OVER w END AS me,
               count(*) OVER w AS me_lines,
               (SELECT CAST(max(session_date) AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL 22 HOUR FROM read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/calendar.parquet') WHERE session_date < CAST(d AS DATE)) AS cutoff,
               CAST(session_date AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL 22 HOUR AS cutoff_clock
        FROM c0 WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_date, cik)),
    s AS (SELECT c.*, st.* EXCLUDE (cik, available_at), st.available_at AS fund_available_at
          FROM c ASOF LEFT JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/ratios/fund_state.parquet') st ON st.cik = c.cik AND c.cutoff > st.available_at),
    k AS (SELECT s.*, exp(-(CASE WHEN s.basis_date IS NULL THEN 0
                                 ELSE coalesce(sd.cum_lr, 0) - coalesce(sbas.cum_lr, 0) END)) AS eps_adj
          FROM s ASOF LEFT JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/ratios/split_events.parquet') sd ON sd.cik = s.cik AND s.session_date >= sd.ex_date
                 ASOF LEFT JOIN read_parquet('C:/atx/atx-db/data/alpha_panel/v1/ratios/split_events.parquet') sbas ON sbas.cik = s.cik AND s.basis_date >= sbas.ex_date),
    x AS (SELECT *, date_diff('day', datadate, session_date) AS staleness_days,
                 coalesce(date_diff('day', datadate, session_date)
                          <= CASE WHEN form0 IN ('20-F', '20-F/A', '40-F', '40-F/A') THEN 550 ELSE 400 END,
                          false) AS fresh_q,
                 coalesce(date_diff('day', fy0_datadate, session_date) <= 550, false) AS fresh_a,
                 me + ev_debt AS ev
          FROM k)
    SELECT session_date, security_id, cik, link_tier, linkprim, prc, shrout, me_line, me, me_lines, eps_adj, fund_available_at, datadate, fqtr, form0, ttm_src, ttm_fy0_items, fy0_datadate, first_datadate, hist_days, fin_template, sic, curcd, fx_converted, absent_items, be_q0, ev, staleness_days, fresh_q, fresh_a,
           CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN CASE WHEN (ni_avg5) <> 0 THEN (me) / (ni_avg5) END END AS capei, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (me) <> 0 THEN (be_q0) / (me) END END AS bm, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (oibdp_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me + ev_debt) / (oibdp_ttm) END END AS evm, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (ib_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (ib_ttm) END END AS pe_issuer_ib, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (ni_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (ni_ttm) END END AS pe_issuer_ni, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS pe_exi, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS pe_inc, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (sale_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (sale_ttm) END END AS ps, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (oancf_ttm) <> 0 THEN (me) / (oancf_ttm) END END AS pcf, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN dpr END AS dpr, CASE WHEN (fresh_q AND fresh_a) THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS peg_trailing, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (me) <> 0 THEN (dvc_ttm) / (me) END END AS divyield_paid, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CASE WHEN (ceq_q0) <> 0 THEN (me) / (ceq_q0) END END AS ptb, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) END AS divyield, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN npm END AS npm, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN opmbd END AS opmbd, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN opmad END AS opmad, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN gpm END AS gpm, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN ptpm END AS ptpm, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN cfm END AS cfm, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN roa END AS roa, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN roe END AS roe, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN roce END AS roce, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN efftax END AS efftax, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN aftret_eq END AS aftret_eq, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN aftret_invcapx END AS aftret_invcapx, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN aftret_equity END AS aftret_equity, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN pretret_noa END AS pretret_noa, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN pretret_earnat END AS pretret_earnat, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN gprof END AS gprof, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN equity_invcap END AS equity_invcap, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN debt_invcap END AS debt_invcap, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN totdebt_invcap END AS totdebt_invcap, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN capital_ratio END AS capital_ratio, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN int_debt END AS int_debt, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN int_totdebt END AS int_totdebt, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN cash_lt END AS cash_lt, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN invt_act END AS invt_act, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN rect_act END AS rect_act, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN debt_at END AS debt_at, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN debt_ebitda END AS debt_ebitda, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN short_debt END AS short_debt, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN curr_debt END AS curr_debt, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN lt_debt END AS lt_debt, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN profit_lct END AS profit_lct, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN ocf_lct END AS ocf_lct, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN cash_debt END AS cash_debt, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN fcf_ocf END AS fcf_ocf, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN lt_ppent END AS lt_ppent, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN dltt_be END AS dltt_be, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN de_ratio END AS de_ratio, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN debt_assets END AS debt_assets, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN debt_capital END AS debt_capital, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN intcov END AS intcov, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN intcov_ratio END AS intcov_ratio, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN cash_ratio END AS cash_ratio, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN quick_ratio END AS quick_ratio, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN curr_ratio END AS curr_ratio, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN cash_conversion END AS cash_conversion, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN at_turn END AS at_turn, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN inv_turn END AS inv_turn, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN pay_turn END AS pay_turn, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN rect_turn END AS rect_turn, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN sale_equity END AS sale_equity, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN sale_invcap END AS sale_invcap, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN sale_nwc END AS sale_nwc, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN accrual END AS accrual, CASE WHEN fresh_q THEN rd_sale END AS rd_sale, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN adv_sale END AS adv_sale, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN piotroski_f END AS piotroski_f, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN CASE WHEN altman_x IS NOT NULL AND lt_a0 <> 0 AND me IS NOT NULL THEN altman_x + 0.6 * me / lt_a0 END END AS altman_z, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN ohlson_o END AS ohlson_o, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN beneish_m END AS beneish_m,
           CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_roa END AS f_roa, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_cfo END AS f_cfo, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_droa END AS f_droa, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_accrual END AS f_accrual, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dlever END AS f_dlever, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dliquid END AS f_dliquid, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_eqoff END AS f_eqoff, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dmargin END AS f_dmargin, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN f_dturn END AS f_dturn, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_dsri END AS m_dsri, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_gmi END AS m_gmi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_aqi END AS m_aqi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_sgi END AS m_sgi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_depi END AS m_depi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_sgai END AS m_sgai, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_lvgi END AS m_lvgi, CASE WHEN fresh_a THEN m_tata END AS m_tata,
           nullif(concat_ws(',', CASE WHEN fresh_a AND ((ni_avg5) = 0 OR coalesce(((fy0_datadate IS NULL AND date_diff('day', first_datadate, datadate) < 300) OR hist_days < 1431), false)) THEN 'capei' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((me) = 0) THEN 'bm' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((oibdp_ttm) = 0) THEN 'evm' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((ib_ttm) = 0) THEN 'pe_issuer_ib' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((ni_ttm) = 0) THEN 'pe_issuer_ni' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((epsfx_ttm * eps_adj) = 0) THEN 'pe_exi' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((epsfi_ttm * eps_adj) = 0) THEN 'pe_inc' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((sale_ttm) = 0) THEN 'ps' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((oancf_ttm) = 0) THEN 'pcf' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((ib_ttm) = 0) THEN 'dpr' END, CASE WHEN (fresh_q AND fresh_a) AND ((eps_g3 * 100) = 0 OR coalesce((((fy0_datadate IS NULL AND date_diff('day', first_datadate, datadate) < 300) OR hist_days < 1066) OR epsfx_a0 <= 0 OR epsfx_a3 <= 0), false)) THEN 'peg_trailing' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((dltt_q0 + dlc_q0) = 0) THEN 'short_debt' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((lt_q0) = 0) THEN 'curr_debt' END, CASE WHEN fresh_q AND ((lt_q0) = 0) THEN 'lt_debt' END, CASE WHEN ratios.definition: Shiller's cyclically adjusted P/E: market equity / mean net income of the last five fiscal years (nominal)
ratios.name: capei

ratios.definition: Book/Market: book equity / market equity
ratios.name: bm

ratios.definition: Enterprise value multiple: (me + dltt + dlc + pstk + mib - che) / EBITDA (oibdp) TTM
ratios.name: evm

ratios.definition: Issuer aggregate common market equity / income before extraordinary items TTM (USD); cap/earnings analog, not diluted EPS P/E
ratios.name: pe_issuer_ib

ratios.definition: Issuer aggregate common market equity / parent net income TTM (USD); cap/earnings analog, not diluted EPS P/E
ratios.name: pe_issuer_ni

ratios.definition: WFRS price / diluted EPS excluding EI; NULL until certified security-class/ADR/EPS share-basis alignment is available
ratios.name: pe_exi

ratios.definition: WFRS price / diluted EPS including EI; NULL until certified security-class/ADR/EPS share-basis alignment is available
ratios.name: pe_inc

ratios.definition: Price/Sales: market equity / sales TTM
ratios.name: ps

ratios.definition: Price/Cash flow: market equity / operating cash flow TTM
ratios.name: pcf

ratios.definition: Dividend payout ratio: common cash dividends TTM / income before extraordinary items TTM
ratios.name: dpr

ratios.definition: Trailing PEG: pe_exi / 3-year compound annual growth (percent) of annual diluted EPS excl. EI (both > 0)
ratios.name: peg_trailing

ratios.definition: Dividend yield: common cash dividends TTM / market equity
ratios.name: divyield_paid

ratios.definition: Price/Book: market equity / common equity
ratios.name: ptb

ratios.definition: Indicated dividend rate / price (WFRS); NULL: no source-backed indicated rate primitive
ratios.name: divyield

ratios.definition: Net profit margin: net income TTM / sales TTM
ratios.name: npm

ratios.definition: Operating profit margin before depreciation: oibdp TTM / sales TTM
ratios.name: opmbd

ratios.definition: Operating profit margin after depreciation: oiadp TTM / sales TTM
ratios.name: opmad

ratios.definition: Gross profit margin: (sales - cogs) TTM / sales TTM
ratios.name: gpm

ratios.definition: Pre-tax profit margin: pretax income / sales (latest fiscal year)
ratios.name: ptpm

ratios.definition: Cash flow margin: (income before extraordinary items + depreciation) TTM / sales TTM
ratios.name: cfm

ratios.definition: Return on assets: oibdp TTM / average total assets
ratios.name: roa

ratios.definition: Return on equity: NI TTM / average (parent stockholder equity + deferred taxes and investment tax credit)
ratios.name: roe

ratios.definition: Return on capital employed: EBIT (NI + tax + interest) TTM / average (dltt + dlc + ceq)
ratios.name: roce

ratios.definition: Effective tax rate: income taxes / pretax income (latest fiscal year)
ratios.name: efftax

ratios.definition: After-tax return on average common equity: NI TTM / average ceq
ratios.name: aftret_eq

ratios.definition: After-tax return on invested capital: (NI + interest) TTM / invested capital
ratios.name: aftret_invcapx

ratios.definition: After-tax return on total stockholders' equity: NI TTM / average seq
ratios.name: aftret_equity

ratios.definition: Pre-tax return on net operating assets: oiadp TTM / average (ppent + act - lct)
ratios.name: pretret_noa

ratios.definition: Pre-tax return on total earning assets: oiadp TTM / average (ppent + act)
ratios.name: pretret_earnat

ratios.definition: Gross profit / total assets (WFRS GProf)
ratios.name: gprof

ratios.definition: Common equity / invested capital
ratios.name: equity_invcap

ratios.definition: Long-term debt / invested capital
ratios.name: debt_invcap

ratios.definition: Total debt (dltt + dlc) / invested capital
ratios.name: totdebt_invcap

ratios.definition: Capitalization ratio: dltt / (dltt + ceq + pstk)
ratios.name: capital_ratio

ratios.definition: Interest TTM / average long-term debt
ratios.name: int_debt

ratios.definition: Interest TTM / average total debt
ratios.name: int_totdebt

ratios.definition: Cash and short-term investments / total liabilities
ratios.name: cash_lt

ratios.definition: Inventory / current assets
ratios.name: invt_act

ratios.definition: Receivables / current assets
ratios.name: rect_act

ratios.definition: Total liabilities / total assets (WFRS debt_at)
ratios.name: debt_at

ratios.definition: Total debt / EBITDA TTM
ratios.name: debt_ebitda

ratios.definition: Short-term debt / total debt
ratios.name: short_debt

ratios.definition: Current liabilities / total liabilities
ratios.name: curr_debt

ratios.definition: Long-term debt / total liabilities
ratios.name: lt_debt

ratios.definition: Operating income before depreciation TTM / current liabilities
ratios.name: profit_lct

ratios.definition: Operating cash flow TTM / current liabilities
ratios.name: ocf_lct

ratios.definition: Operating cash flow TTM / total debt
ratios.name: cash_debt

ratios.definition: Free cash flow / operating cash flow
ratios.name: fcf_ocf

ratios.definition: Total liabilities / total tangible assets (AT - INTAN)
ratios.name: lt_ppent

ratios.definition: Long-term debt / book equity
ratios.name: dltt_be

ratios.definition: Total debt/equity: total liabilities / shareholders' equity (common and preferred)
ratios.name: de_ratio

ratios.definition: Financial debt / total assets
ratios.name: debt_assets

ratios.definition: Total debt/capital: (ap + dlc + dltt) / (ap + dlc + dltt + ceq + pstk)
ratios.name: debt_capital

ratios.definition: After-tax interest coverage: (xint + ib) TTM / xint TTM
ratios.name: intcov

ratios.definition: Interest coverage ratio: EBIT (NI + tax + interest) TTM / xint TTM
ratios.name: intcov_ratio

ratios.definition: Cash and short-term investments / current liabilities
ratios.name: cash_ratio

ratios.definition: Quick ratio (acid test): (current assets - inventories) / current liabilities
ratios.name: quick_ratio

ratios.definition: Current ratio: current assets / current liabilities
ratios.name: curr_ratio

ratios.definition: Cash conversion cycle (days): 365 x (inventories / cogs + receivables / sales - payables / cogs), current balances and TTM flows
ratios.name: cash_conversion

ratios.definition: Asset turnover: sales TTM / average total assets
ratios.name: at_turn

ratios.definition: Inventory turnover: cogs TTM / average inventories
ratios.name: inv_turn

ratios.definition: Payables turnover: (cogs TTM + change in inventories over the year) / average accounts payable
ratios.name: pay_turn

ratios.definition: Receivables turnover: sales TTM / average receivables
ratios.name: rect_turn

ratios.definition: Sales TTM / stockholders' equity
ratios.name: sale_equity

ratios.definition: Sales TTM / invested capital
ratios.name: sale_invcap

ratios.definition: Sales TTM / working capital (act - lct)
ratios.name: sale_nwc

ratios.definition: Accruals / average total assets: (ib - oancf) TTM / average at (Sloan sign)
ratios.name: accrual

ratios.definition: R&D expense TTM / sales TTM
ratios.name: rd_sale

ratios.definition: Advertising expense / sales (latest fiscal year)
ratios.name: adv_sale

ratios.definition: Piotroski (2000) F-score: sum of nine indicators on annual data (f_roa ib/at_t-1 > 0; f_cfo oancf/at_t-1 > 0; f_droa change in roa > 0; f_accrual cfo > roa; f_dlever change in dltt / average at < 0; f_dliquid change in current ratio > 0; f_eqoff sstk = 0; f_dmargin change in gross margin > 0; f_dturn change in sale/at_t-1 > 0); NULL unless all nine are defined
ratios.name: piotroski_f

ratios.definition: Altman (1968) Z = 1.2 (act - lct)/at + 1.4 re/at + 3.3 oiadp/at + 0.6 me/lt + 1.0 sale/at (latest fiscal year; me of the session)
ratios.name: altman_z

ratios.definition: Ohlson (1980) model 1 O = -1.32 - 0.407 ln(at, USD millions, undeflated) + 6.03 lt/at - 1.43 (act - lct)/at + 0.0757 lct/act - 1.72 [lt > at] - 2.37 ni/at - 1.83 oancf/lt + 0.285 [ni < 0 both years] - 0.521 (ni_t - ni_t-1)/(|ni_t| + |ni_t-1|) (latest fiscal year)
ratios.name: ohlson_o

ratios.definition: Beneish (1999) 8-variable M = -4.84 + 0.920 DSRI + 0.528 GMI + 0.404 AQI + 0.892 SGI + 0.115 DEPI - 0.172 SGAI + 4.679 TATA - 0.327 LVGI (fiscal years t and t-1; TATA = (ib - oancf)/at)
ratios.name: beneish_m

handcheck.rule:
